claims.quote: Brachyrhamdia meesi is a small heptapterid catfish described from near Belém, at the mouth of the Amazon in Brazil.
Its precise distribution is unclear, with one record from the Río Madre de Dios basin in Peru.
Type locality is 'near Belem, Brazil', i.e., the city of Belém near the mouth of the Amazon River in Pará state.
Its precise distribution is unclear, however, with one record pertaining to the Río Madre de Dios basin, several thousand kilometres from Belém in southeastern Perú.
